zh.title: Discovery紀錄片首度深入華航修護廠 揭飛安關鍵
zh.summary: 華航修護廠紀錄片；飛安體系；人才培育
body: Discovery頻道新紀錄片「工程先鋒：飛航守護者」首度深入中華航空修護工廠，涵蓋從拆卸、檢查、維護、回裝到測試的流程與層層作業驗證，呈現華航的維修與飛安體系、人才培育與安全文化。
紀錄片今天在記者會公開精彩片段，華航董事長高星潢與總經理陳漢銘出席觀影。影片也深入華航24小時修管中心，呈現地面團隊如何即時監控機隊運行。
華航修護訓練中心運用MR（混合實境）與模擬教學設備培育修護人才。高星潢表示，「錢可以借，專業設備可以買，但人是培養出來，達到為永續經營的關鍵」。

en.title: Discovery Documentary Goes Behind the Scenes at China Airlines' MRO Facility
en.summary: Discovery documentary tours China Airline Maintenance MRO; safety culture; MR training
body: Discovery Channel's new documentary "Engineering Pioneers: Aviation Guardians" offers an in-depth look at China Airlines' maintenance factory, covering the process of disassembly, inspection, reinstallation and testing with layered verification to reveal the carrier's maintenance and flight safety system, talent development, and safety culture.

Highlights were shown at a press conference attended by Chairman Kao Shing-Huang and General Manager Chen Han-Ming. The documentary also features the carrier's 24-hour maintenance monitoring center and its ground team's real-time fleet monitoring.

The maintenance training center uses Mixed Reality (MR) and simulation equipment to train new maintenance personnel. Kao said money and equipment can be borrowed or bought, but people must be cultivated and are the key to sustainable operations.

zh.title: 西班牙軍方雜誌透露選用A321改裝訊號情報偵察機 尚未正式公告
zh.summary: 軍方雜誌提及選用A321執行訊號情報任務，蒐集雷達與通訊訊號；選型尚未正式公告。
body: AeroTime於10月6日報導，西班牙空天軍官方雜誌《Revista de Aeronáutica y Astronáutica》提及，軍方已為Santiago II-SCAPA訊號情報計畫選用空中巴士A321，作為未來有人駕駛偵察機的改裝基礎。不過，截至報導當日，西班牙國防部、空中巴士與Indra均未正式公告這項選型。
訊號情報（SIGINT）是透過接收與分析雷達、無線電通訊等電磁訊號蒐集情報。這項計畫將在飛機上整合電子情報與通訊情報設備，使其具備空中偵察能力。
空中巴士於2025年12月30日公告，與Indra獲選進行為期18個月的研究，評估適合的飛機與情報設備，規劃三架偵察機的方案。空中巴士負責提出飛機方案，並在後續階段改裝飛機、整合Indra提出的情報系統；該公告未指定A321。
依AeroTime報導，西班牙部長會議於2025年11月18日核准研究合約，估計金額為1600萬歐元。計畫第一階段評估機型與設備整合方式，第二階段才在三架飛機上建置訊號情報能力。
軍方雜誌另提到，日後可能以相同機型發展空中預警（AEW）方案，監測空中目標並提供預警；但這項延伸計畫尚未正式啟動，不能視為已獲核准的A321預警機採購案。

en.title: Spanish military magazine indicates A321 selection for signals intelligence aircraft; no formal announcement
en.summary: A service magazine mentions choosing the A321 for signals intelligence missions; the selection has not been formally announced.
body: AeroTime reported on October 6 that the Spanish Air and Space Force's official magazine, Revista de Aeronáutica y Astronáutica, referred to choosing the Airbus A321 for the Santiago II-SCAPA signals intelligence program. Spain's Ministry of Defense, Airbus and Indra had not formally announced the selection as of that date.

Signals intelligence (SIGINT) gathers intelligence by receiving and analyzing electromagnetic emissions, including radar and radio communications. The project would integrate electronic and communications intelligence equipment into crewed aircraft.

Airbus announced on December 30, 2025, that it and Indra would conduct an 18-month study of suitable aircraft and equipment for a three-aircraft solution. Airbus would propose the aircraft and later modify them to integrate Indra's proposed intelligence system. That announcement did not specify the A321.

According to AeroTime, Spain's Council of Ministers approved the study contract on November 18, 2025, at an estimated €16 million. An initial assessment and integration study would precede installation of SIGINT capabilities on three aircraft.

The magazine also raised the possibility of using the same aircraft type for airborne early warning (AEW), which monitors airborne targets and provides warning. That separate program has not been formally launched and does not constitute an approved A321 AEW procurement.
